name: pythia-mobile
description: Capacitor shell that ships the Pythia frontend to the Play Store.

scripts.sync: node sync-web.js && cap sync && node patch-android.js
scripts.android: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && cap open ios
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.build:aab: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
